action_eligibility: At least two distinct complete fit H in the exact same C/i/full Z; construct every such group even without eval match.
qualified_matched: Eval matches one eligible fit group. Five-distribution comparisons are defined on qualified matched states only; seen and all qualified matched are descriptive.
unqualified: Any-fit-Z matched but single-fit-H states have coverage counts only. New component metrics are NA, not zero. Original head raw/head TV remains available on all eval main states.
novel: Complete eval H absent from every fit branch at same C/i, including all other Z groups.
zero: m=0 remains in the eligible matched population and primary intervals; internal rho=0, displayed rho is NA when t=0.
access: Independent identity/export readers read full original bytes, including eval and old effect fields. The action constructor does not read eval values, mixed effect records, or effect summaries; its full bank is signed before the eval scorer reads eval target.
audit_scope: Recorded Python open paths, whitelist schema, source review and file SHA; not an OS isolation guarantee between same-UID processes.
